rationale: The discovery and option-selection behavior is already required by the shared new-feature workflow for both hosts.
The durable plan and review checkpoint are already owned by the shared new-feature workflow for both hosts.
The reproduce-isolate-fix loop is already required by the shared fix-bug workflow for both hosts.
Native subagents and their evidence gates are already selected by the host-neutral feature workflow and reviewer dispatcher.
Plan execution and its review checkpoints are already owned by the shared feature workflow.
The reviewer dispatcher owns fresh independent review selection, fallback, receipt binding, and closure.
Review-comment triage and repair are already required by the shared review-comments workflow.
Simplification is a bounded review phase in the shared feature workflow and has no independent portable callsite.
Verification is already owned by verify-app verify-e2e and the shared evidence gates.
